name: komdosh-dev-spring-delivery
description: Everything between 'a ticket exists' and 'the release PR is open'. Lifecycle orchestration (/lifecycle status|next|orchestrate|audit computes a gate map from real git state and recommends the next action; /recommend routes a task to the right marketplace capability), Jira-driven task entry (/jira-task pulls a ticket via the Atlassian MCP and walks its workflow forward), architecture-driven planning (/implementation-plan turns a service's architecture package into ordered agent todos), and two-track release engineering — service (/release-prep, /changelog, /version-bump, /release-notes, /rollback-playbook) and library (adds /abi-check, /publish-prep, /deprecate-api, with ABI-load-bearing version bumps). 4 agents · 12 commands · 11 skills · 2 rules. Never deploys, never pushes tags, never merges a PR. Requires komdosh-dev-spring-core.
